name: Payments to intermediaries in neighbouring transit jurisdictions
description: Commodity proceeds are settled through agents or companies in jurisdictions adjacent to conflict areas and then forwarded onward.
fp: Regional hubs are common commercial centres.

sources.text: FATF, Financing of the Terrorist Organisation Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) (2015)
FATF, Financing of Recruitment for Terrorist Purposes (2018)
FATF, Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment Guidance (2019)
